name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-impact renovations for rental properties often include kitchen and bathroom updates, fresh paint, and durable flooring. These improvements appeal to a broader range of tenants, increase property value, and can justify higher rental rates. Focus on modern, neutral finishes that are easy to maintain and can withstand tenant turnover.
